support_notes: EuropeanPricer, PathDependentPricer and LsmcPricer are fixed-GBM helpers; their models field is empty because no registry model key is supplied.
European serial and parallel estimates replay identically with the same seed, grid and inputs.
For one-step LsmcPricer antithetics, num_paths=N counts independent pair means and num_simulated_paths=2N counts generated trajectories. Compare with 2N plain samples at the same raw-path budget.
The captured GBM helper includes the initial state; it does not expose engine or scheme injection.
Four times as many independent samples halves the theoretical standard-error scale, not the realized absolute error of every seed.
The source set also includes stochastic_processes, discretization_schemes and monte_carlo_simulation; the principal notebook identifies the replay proof.

expected_exceptions.condition: pricing_seed equals the training seed; the message identifies pricing_seed.

support_notes: asian_option_price with arithmetic averaging is the Turnbull-Wakeman approximation; geometric averaging uses the exact benchmark. One terminal fixing reduces both to the matched European contract.
barrier_call prices continuous monitoring and accepts no monitoring-frequency parameter. The discrete sweep uses nested observations on the same captured fine paths.
price_american_put_unbiased evaluates a fitted exercise policy on independent pricing paths. Its Monte Carlo interval does not include exercise-grid or learned-policy error.

No exercise-boundary object is exposed by LsmcPricer. A clearly labelled prescribed schematic is independent of engine output; actual spot-price and path-count plots report held-out policy values with sampling bars and explicit policy/grid-error limits.

Fixed-strike lookback is computed directly on captured GBM paths and dominates the matched terminal vanilla payoff path by path. The continuous fixed-strike helper is deliberately excluded: its M>=K branch calls the floating-strike formula, creating a discontinuity at K=M (17.216802 at K=100 versus 19.167624 at K=100.000001 for S=M=100, r=5%, q=0, sigma=20%, T=1). No analytical accuracy claim is made for the substituted discrete payoff.

quanto_option_price is validated by a correlation sweep with domestic-currency-per-foreign FX quotation and unit contractual conversion: effective foreign-equity drift r_f-q-rho*sigma_s*sigma_fx; equal domestic/foreign rates with rho=0 reduce to the vanilla formula.

The mapped exotic_rates notebook prices an explicitly configured co-terminal Bermudan with both registered Hull-White 1F tree and Monte Carlo models. Seed replay, path count, finite standard error and a fixture-specific cross-method tolerance execute. The default LSMC diagnostic is not a held-out policy-error bound; this registered wrapper does not expose the independent pricing_seed argument of the standalone GBM helper.

expected_exceptions.condition: The BBB fixture has a fixed coupon; the floating discount-margin solver rejects it.

support_notes: The supported JSON instrument type is autocallable, dispatched through its registered GBM model. All observed fixings are supplied, so this proof takes the deterministic known-redemption branch.
Zero coupons, unreachable autocall barriers and a zero discount rate isolate the final capital-protection, participation and knock-in-put redemption contracts.
The note holder is short the knock-in put: principal is reduced by the put loss after breach. A breach followed by full spot recovery returns principal.
This proof is a payoff-contract identity, not an issuer-credit or new-issue valuation model.

StructuredCredit requires actual positive PoolAssets for pricing; metadata-only rep lines are not a substitute. The separate track fixture tests supply the pool, waterfall and base-correlation evidence.

The mapped exotic_rates notebook hand-reconciles the TARN target and truncated final coupon, snowball recursion, inverse-floater gearing, and an inclusive range-accrual observation fraction. These are coupon-profile arithmetic helpers, not complete callable-note or issuer-credit valuation models.
The two-asset cashflow waterfall now directly reconciles all three native tranche PVs to one-period receipts, with real positive PoolAssets.
Finite-pool Gaussian exposures use sqrt(asset correlation) loadings. Expected pool loss is PD times LGD times notional; exact pathwise loss tranches reconcile to native tranche statistics.
The native breakeven CDR is the first-writedown threshold, not a par-price target. OAS reprices model price to approximately zero spread; fixed-coupon discount margin is explicitly rejected.
Cash-stack attachment coordinates differ from the loss-only tranche coordinates used by PortfolioLossResult. Base-correlation knots are detachment percentage points; correlations are decimals.
